exampleEn: After a long week at work, I like to wind down with a good book.
exampleKo: 긴 일주일을 보낸 후, 나는 좋은 책으로 긴장을 푸는 것을 좋아한다.
gameExamples: To help me wind down after my workout, I enjoy taking a hot shower.
On weekends, I often wind down by watching my favorite movies.
It's important to wind down before bed to ensure a good night's sleep.
